1. What is the JAANCH Autoimmune Advanced Package by Thyrocare?
The JAANCH Autoimmune Advanced Package is a specialised blood testing package from Thyrocare designed to evaluate laboratory markers associated with autoimmune conditions. It can support doctors in investigating symptoms that may be caused by an abnormal immune response.
2. What are autoimmune diseases?
Autoimmune diseases occur when the immune system, which normally protects the body from infections, mistakenly targets the bodys own cells or tissues. Depending on the condition, this abnormal immune response may affect the joints, skin, muscles, glands, blood vessels or internal organs.
3. What symptoms may indicate the need for an autoimmune blood test?
Autoimmune testing may be considered when symptoms such as persistent joint pain, morning stiffness, unexplained fatigue, recurring fever, muscle pain, skin rashes, swelling or prolonged unexplained health problems are present. These symptoms can have many other causes, so a doctor should determine whether autoimmune testing is appropriate.
4. What conditions can the Thyrocare JAANCH Autoimmune Advanced Package help evaluate?
Depending on the markers included, autoimmune testing may assist in the evaluation of conditions such as rheumatoid arthritis, lupus (SLE), Sjögrens syndrome and other autoimmune or connective tissue disorders. The exact tests included in the package should be checked before booking.
5. Can a positive autoimmune test confirm that I have an autoimmune disease?
No. A positive antibody or abnormal autoimmune marker does not independently confirm a diagnosis. Some markers may occur in multiple autoimmune conditions and can occasionally be found in otherwise healthy individuals. Diagnosis requires correlation with symptoms, clinical examination and other investigations.
6. Can autoimmune disease be present even if some blood test results are normal?
Yes. Autoimmune diseases can be complex, and no single laboratory test can detect every autoimmune condition. A normal result does not always completely exclude an autoimmune disorder. If symptoms persist, your doctor may recommend additional or more specific investigations.
7. Is fasting required for the JAANCH Autoimmune Advanced Package by Thyrocare?
Fasting requirements depend on the exact investigations included in the package. Follow the preparation instructions provided when booking your Thyrocare test. Unless fasting is specifically advised, do not change medications or diet without consulting your doctor.
8. Who should consider the Thyrocare JAANCH Autoimmune Advanced Package?
The package may be considered by people with persistent symptoms suggestive of an autoimmune condition, individuals with a family or medical history that increases clinical suspicion, or patients specifically advised by a doctor to undergo detailed autoimmune screening.
9. What should I do if my autoimmune test results are abnormal?
Abnormal autoimmune results should be reviewed by a qualified doctor. Depending on your symptoms and the particular markers involved, you may be advised to undergo additional investigations or consult a rheumatologist or another appropriate specialist.

It includes TTG Antibody IgA, Anti Deamidated Gliadin Peptide IgA and IgG, along with Complete Hemogram and Iron Deficiency profile for a comprehensive evaluation.

This package helps in early detection of celiac disease and associated nutritional deficiencies, allowing timely dietary and medical intervention.
